_comment: p95 budgets in ms = 2x the p95 measured in CI (board/API: docs/release/performance-baseline-2026-10-27.md; open/save/move/create and mobile: the 2026-10-28 CI run), rounded up to 100 ms. Raise a budget only with a new measurement. The product targets (docs/release/performance-baseline-2026-10-27.md) are stricter than the budgets, which only catch regressions.
